Specification: TLC-ready version of the simple blocking Atomic Commitment Protocol (ACP_SB). Extends ACP_SB and TLC, adds symmetry via Permutations, and rewrites AC4 in a form better handled by the TLC model checker.
TemporalSubscript: [][ /\ (\A i \in participants : participant[i].decision = commit => (participant'[i].decision = commit)) /\ (\A j \in participants : participant[j].decision = abort => (participant'[j].decision = abort))]_<<participant>>
AlwaysOp: [][ /\ (\A i \in participants : participant[i].decision = commit => (participant'[i].decision = commit)) /\ (\A j \in participants : participant[j].decision = abort => (participant'[j].decision = abort))]_<<participant>>
DivisionNotes: TemporalNesting is set to true because of the double temporal operator [][...] in the AC4_alt definition [1].
Perms is categorized as OperatorDefNames_ValueDef because it defines the set of permutations for symmetry [1], [2].
AC4_alt is categorized as OperatorDefNames_TemporalProperty because it defines a safety invariant using the box operator [1], [3].
